issues: What the Research Actually Shows: the Northwestern study details (32 exercises, 30 minutes daily, ages 40–65, apparent age 50.8 to 48.1, cheek fullness, JAMA Dermatology) are not in the supplied evidence. The evidence only supports 27 recruited, 16 completed, small sample, middle-aged women.
